title: renameUnit
responsibility: Gives a unit another readable id, keeping its uid, contract and history and updating every specification reference.

inputs.name: renameUnit.from
inputs.description: The current id of the unit to rename; it must exactly match a stored unit whose status is active, and that unit's spec file is then renamed to the new id. An unknown or retired id throws ExpectedCliError before the first specification file is rewritten or renamed.

inputs.name: renameUnit.to
inputs.description: The new id: lowercase letters and digits, with single dots or dashes allowed only between them, and it must not equal the id of any stored unit, whatever its status, because ids are never reused. A malformed or already-used id throws ExpectedCliError before the first specification file is rewritten or renamed.

inputs.name: renameUnit.options
inputs.description: Optional settings: root is the project root passed to loadUnits and defaults to process.cwd(), and now is the clock whose result is recorded as retired.at on the old id's tombstone and defaults to new Date().toISOString(). When the whole object is omitted (default {}), both fallbacks apply.

outputs.name: renameUnit
outputs.description: Resolves to a RenameReport: from and to repeat the ids passed in, and rewritten lists, in sorted order and relative to the project root, each spec file under specification/units that had the old id in its dependencies, composition uses or contract primitives. The list is empty when no spec file had it.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Thrown through fail() when from is unknown or retired, when to is not a valid unit id, or when a stored unit already has the id to, whatever its status. All three checks run before the first specification file is rewritten or renamed.
